proposals.evidence: CDIAL 43 akṣi explicitly gives Phal. ac̣hi, Bengali ā̃khi, Hindi ā̃kh and Nepali ā̃kho “eye”. The survey affricate/nasal/kh variants identify this eye family; contracted ā̃kā retains a phonetic qualification. Reviewed comparator: Rana akʰi “eye” (f_seyt2aozzak5s). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.
